```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggparliament)
library(htmltools)
source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
# Load data
bills    <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/bills.csv"),     show_col_types = FALSE)
history  <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/history.csv"),   show_col_types = FALSE)
people   <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/people.csv"),    show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(first_name), first_name != "")
votes     <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/votes.csv"),    show_col_types = FALSE)
rollcalls <- read_csv(here::here("legiscan/files_ga91_derived/rollcalls.csv"),show_col_types = FALSE)

bill_groups_path <- here::here("data/legislature/bills/groups.rds")
if (file.exists(bill_groups_path)) {
  bill_groups <- read_rds(bill_groups_path)
} else {
  bill_groups <- NULL
}
```

```{r}
# Identify replaced legislators (shared helper; see R/legislature/utils.R)
former_ids <- classify_district_turnover(people, votes, rollcalls) |>
  filter(is_former) |>
  pull(people_id)

active_people <- people |> filter(!people_id %in% former_ids)

# Party composition for each chamber
party_colours <- c("R" = "#A8433A", "D" = "#3F5B93")

house_comp  <- active_people |> filter(role == "Rep") |> count(party, name = "seats") |> arrange(desc(seats))
senate_comp <- active_people |> filter(role == "Sen") |> count(party, name = "seats") |> arrange(desc(seats))

n_house_R  <- house_comp  |> filter(party == "R") |> pull(seats)
n_house_D  <- house_comp  |> filter(party == "D") |> pull(seats)
n_senate_R <- senate_comp |> filter(party == "R") |> pull(seats)
n_senate_D <- senate_comp |> filter(party == "D") |> pull(seats)

# Headline counts
n_bills        <- nrow(bills)
n_house_bills  <- sum(str_detect(bills$bill_number, "^HF|^HJR|^HR"))
n_senate_bills <- sum(str_detect(bills$bill_number, "^SF|^SJR|^SR"))

n_R <- nrow(active_people |> filter(party == "R"))
n_D <- nrow(active_people |> filter(party == "D"))

# Bill progress stage counts (individual bill status, furthest reached)
status_order <- c("Introduced", "Passed Subcommittee", "Passed Committee",
                  "Passed One Chamber", "Passed Both Chambers", "Signed by Governor")

if (!is.null(bill_groups)) {
  stage_counts <- bill_groups |>
    count(status, name = "n") |>
    mutate(status = factor(status, levels = status_order)) |>
    arrange(status)
  n_signed      <- stage_counts |> filter(status == "Signed by Governor")  |> pull(n) |> (\(x) if (length(x)) x else 0L)()
  n_passed_both <- stage_counts |> filter(status == "Passed Both Chambers") |> pull(n) |> (\(x) if (length(x)) x else 0L)()
} else {
  stage_counts  <- NULL
  n_signed      <- NA_integer_
  n_passed_both <- NA_integer_
}
```

```{r}
# Hero
div(class = "ia-hero-row",
  div(
    div(class = "ia-eyebrow", "2025–2026 Session"),
    h1("Tracking the 91st General Assembly"),
    p(class = "ia-lead",
      "Bill information, legislator profiles, voting records, and lobbyist ",
      "declarations — aggregated from ",
      a(href = "https://legiscan.com/IA", "LegiScan"),
      " and the official ",
      a(href = "https://www.legis.iowa.gov/", "Iowa Legislature"),
      " site.")

```

```{r}
# Headline stat cards
ui_stat_grid(
  ui_stat_card("Total Bills", format(n_bills, big.mark = ","),
               sprintf("%s House · %s Senate",
                       format(n_house_bills, big.mark = ","),
                       format(n_senate_bills, big.mark = ","))),
  ui_stat_card("Signed by Governor", format(n_signed, big.mark = ","),
               sprintf("%.1f%% of all bills introduced", 100 * n_signed / n_bills)),
  ui_stat_card("Awaiting Governor", format(n_passed_both, big.mark = ","),
               "Passed both chambers"),
  ui_stat_card("Legislators", format(nrow(active_people), big.mark = ","),
               sprintf("%d R · %d D across both chambers", n_R, n_D))
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 2.4
house_parl <- parliament_data(
  election_data = house_comp,  type = "semicircle",
  parl_rows = 6, party_seats = house_comp$seats
) |> mutate(chamber = "Iowa House")

senate_parl <- parliament_data(
  election_data = senate_comp, type = "semicircle",
  parl_rows = 4, party_seats = senate_comp$seats
) |> mutate(chamber = "Iowa Senate")

bind_rows(house_parl, senate_parl) |>
  mutate(chamber = factor(chamber, levels = c("Iowa House", "Iowa Senate"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x, y, colour = party)) +
  geom_parliament_seats(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~chamber) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = party_colours) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_ggparliament() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
tally <- function(r, d) {
  # R/D letters so party isn't conveyed by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1)
  HTML(sprintf(
    '<span class="ia-tally-num"><span style="color:#A8433A"><span style="font-size:0.7em">R</span> %d</span> <span style="color:#b5b2a8">–</span> <span style="color:#3F5B93">%d <span style="font-size:0.7em">D</span></span></span>',
    r, d))
}
div(style = "display:flex; margin-top:0.4rem",
  div(class = "ia-tally", tally(n_house_R, n_house_D),  div(class = "ia-tally-label", "House · 100 seats")),
  div(class = "ia-tally", tally(n_senate_R, n_senate_D), div(class = "ia-tally-label", "Senate · 50 seats"))
)
```

```{r}
  div(class = "ia-card-title", "Recent activity"),

```

```{r}
recent <- bills |>
  arrange(desc(last_action_date)) |>
  head(8) |>
  left_join(bill_groups |> select(bill, bill_status = status),
            by = c("bill_number" = "bill")) |>
  mutate(
    display_status = coalesce(bill_status, status_desc),
    short_title    = vapply(title, \(t) clean_bill_title(t)$title, character(1))
  )

rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(recent)), function(i) {
  div(class = "ia-recent-row",
    div(class = "ia-recent-bill", HTML(format_bill_link(recent$bill_number[i], "legislation/"))),
    div(
      div(class = "ia-recent-title", recent$short_title[i]),
      div(class = "ia-recent-meta",  recent$last_action[i])
    ),
    status_pill(recent$display_status[i]),
    div(class = "ia-recent-date", str_squish(format(recent$last_action_date[i], "%b %e, %Y")))
  )
})
div(class = "ia-recent-list", rows)
```
